evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: CMRVision is evaluated on two downstream tasks: multi-task segmentation across cine, late gadolinium enhancement (LGE), and mapping sequences, and cine view classification.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: For cine view classification, CMRVision achieved the highest average accuracy (0.906), compared to prior methods reported in the literature.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across a multi-task segmentation benchmark, CMRVision achieved the strongest overall performance, outperforming prior natural-image (NI), medical-image, supervised, and CMR foundation model baselines.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: In a zero-shot segmentation task on unseen LGE long-axis views, the model achieved an average Dice score of 0.692, demonstrating cross-view generalization.

declaredVenue: Accepted at MedAGI 2026 (peer-reviewed workshop at MICCAI 2026)
